_about: Damage-model constants for a Monster Hunter Wilds build optimizer (game Ver 1.041). User assumptions: hitzone = 100 for raw and element, no monster resistance, every hit lands. Primary source is the game data dump dtlnor/MHWs-in-json (PlayerStatusParam, PlayerSkillParam, SkillData); community sources are only used where the dump is not yet decoded. 'true' units everywhere unless a key says display (display attack = true x bloat, display element = true x 10). Keys marked VERIFY are interpretations of raw parameter arrays that still need an in-game check.

formula.raw_per_hit: trueRawFinal * MV/100 * sharpRaw * critRaw * hitzoneRaw/100 * postMultipliers
formula.trueRawFinal: (baseTrueRaw * prod(attack_pct multipliers) + sum(flat attack)) ; percent sources: Attack Boost 4/5, Heroics, Offensive Guard, Lord's Soul, Seregios II, Prayers II, Fortify
formula.trueEleFinal: (baseTrueEle * prod(ele_pct multipliers) + sum(flat element)) capped by element_cap ; percent sources: element attack Lv2/3, Coalescence, Charge Master, Gogmapocalypse, Dark Arts
formula.critRaw: 1 + aff/100 * (critMult - 1) for aff in [0,100]; 1 + |aff|/100 * (0.75 - 1) for aff < 0
formula.critEle: 1 + max(aff,0)/100 * (critEleMult - 1) only with Critical Element equipped, else 1
formula.efr_efe: Effective Raw = trueRawFinal * sharpRaw * critRaw ; Effective Element = min(trueEleFinal,cap) * sharpEle * critEle. Weapon-combo independent, so the optimizer can rank builds on EFR + EFE per 100 MV. Motion values exist in the dump (Wp??_Attack.rcol '_Attack' field) for a later combo-DPS mode.
formula.stacking_note: Community consensus (wiggler.pet): ((Base * Raw%) + Flat) * Post. Which percent sources multiply vs add to each other is NOT verified for Wilds - treat as multiplicative and flag.

constants_from_game_data.raw_cap_true: max(base * 4.0, base + 400) per source class; all sources max(base * 5.0, base + 600) - never reached in practice

frenzy_overcome.note: base Frenzy mechanic; this is what Black Eclipse I gives you (plus the Frenzy outbreak risk)

bloat_divider._about: display attack / bloat = true raw; derived from the API (raw vs display) on every weapon

sharpness._about: Community values (wiggler.pet; same table as World/Rise). Not yet located in the data dump. Element blue 1.0625 vs 1.05 and purple 1.25 vs 1.27 differ between sources - VERIFY.

weapon_index._about: Wp index used by the game data arrays

skill_values._about: Per level. attack = flat true raw, attack_pct = multiplier in %, aff = affinity %, ele = flat true element, ele_pct = element multiplier in %. 'uptime' is the knob the optimizer exposes for conditional skills.
